_comment: Same character extracted under TWO ids, because the designer named the scene prop differently in different scenes (a fuller name, a pre-reveal alias, a flashback copy). Distinct from reattributions.json, which moves lines to a DIFFERENT character: here both ids are the same person, so leaving them split means one character gets cast twice and speaks with two voices. Applied by merge_characters.py <game>: the source is folded into the target (target's casting wins), and the merge is recorded in app/data/<game>/merges.json exactly as the lab's own merge action records it. Merge direction is always small -> large, so the id that already carries the character's dialogue and casting survives. Idempotent: a rule whose source is already gone is a no-op.

dragonfall.reason: a2_abandonedlab_s1 has props 'Phil', 'Philip Rex' and 'Flashback Phil 2/3/4' -- all the same man, Philip Rex, whom the lab dialogue calls Phil. Six lines in Lab_PC_RecordsRoom stayed under the short name once the owner fix moved the other 109 to Philip Rex.

One man, spelled two ways by the game itself: the scene prop is 'Dr. Xabier Ezkibel' in convo 527028b86636614822004e81 and 'Dr. Exabier Ezkibel' in 52b2266f346238601800433d. Same Basque name with a stray leading E, the same way the data spells Blitz 'Bltiz' elsewhere. Both were cast as Mortimer Nocturne so nothing already generated changes voice; the merge stops him appearing in the lab as two people and being re-cast apart later.

One man. Adrian Vauclair's 29 lines are all inside Green Winters' recordings convo (5266f911663661b825003110), where he opens 'Hermie... I think we've found her. Feuerschwinge... I knew that she wasn't dead!' - Vauclair twenty years before you meet him, talking to his brother. Leaving them split gives the same character two voices: Walter Hansen in person with 390 takes, Benjamin Parker in the recordings.

hk.reason: One person: both buckets carry Raymond's distinctive stutter ('f-finally', 'h-h-help', 'ch-charming'). The scene props are labelled 'Raymond' in hk_hub/a3_showdown_s2/a3_tsangtower_s2 and 'Raymond Tsang' in a3_showdown_s1.

One person: the broadcast lines are self-identifying ('Constables. This is Krait.') and both buckets are the same female Chief Inspector. Prop is 'Chief Inspector Krait' in mc_a1_intro_s1 and 'Krait' in mc_a3_taipo.

Is0bel before you learn her name. Same portrait key (npc_dwarfFemale_Is0bel), and her own stage directions say so: 'The dwarf cuts in. Her voice is soft, but strong', 'Is0bel isn't listening. She is staring open-mouthed at her own PDA'. She also argues with Gobbet by name. 35 lines in the a1_Docks runners' meeting.

Senior Inspector Andy Lam, who introduces himself by that full title in MC_Hub_Impound-InspectorBriefing. Same portrait (NPC_HumanMale_Shadows_Andy); the short entry holds his briefing dialogue and the long one his mission-computer mail signed 'Senior Inspector Lam'.
